license_commitment.description: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the license key; the key itself never travels, is never chained and never exported (client decision 2026-09-03). The commitment is public (every verification package carries it) and proves nothing by itself: possession of the key is proven by license_proof

license_proof.description: proof of possession of the license key (heartbeat spec 4.1): lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256 (RFC 2104) keyed with the UTF-8 bytes of the license key over the ASCII bytes of device_pubkey (64 chars) immediately followed by appliance_id (36 chars), exactly as carried in this message (100 bytes, no separator). The server recomputes it with the stored key, compares in constant time and refuses a missing or different value with 403 license_proof_invalid before anything is registered, regardless of the declared spec_version. Reference values: spec/contract/license_proof.json

spec_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the specification the appliance implements (format spec 10.6); the server accepts every MINOR of its own MAJOR and steers the anchor contract by it (heartbeat spec section 6/9)
